{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Meat and Poultry|Meat]] | [[Cookbook:California cuisine|California cuisine]]

==Ingredients==
* 2 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] cooked [[Cookbook:Rice|brown rice]]
* 20 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]] of extra lean ground [[Cookbook:Turkey|turkey]] breast
* 1 can (12 ounces) diced [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomato]]es with [[Cookbook:Chiles|green chiles]]
* 1 ounce [[Cookbook:Vegetable oil|vegetable oil]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoon]] [[Cookbook:Teriyaki Sauce|teriyaki sauce]]
* Seasonings to taste (e.g. [[Cookbook:Garlic Powder|garlic powder]], [[Cookbook:Lemon Pepper|lemon pepper]], [[Cookbook:Allspice|allspice]], etc.)

==Procedure==
# Spray [[cookbook:skillet|skillet]] with [[Cookbook:Cooking Spray|cooking spray]], and sprinkle in garlic powder and other seasonings. Add turkey, and crumble it as it cooks. Add tomatoes, and mix with turkey until turkey is cooked.
# Add cooking oil to a [[Cookbook:Wok|wok]] or deep [[Cookbook:Skillet|skillet]]. Add 1 teaspoon allspice and/or other seasonings.
# As pan heats slowly add cooked rice (watch for splattering of hot oil). When rice is heated evenly add teriyaki sauce, and mix it evenly.
# When ground turkey is done cooking add it to rice in wok, mix it thoroughly, and serve.

==Nutritional information==

*Carbohydrates per serving: 21.5 g
*Sugar per serving: 2.5 g
*Protein per serving: 35.25 g
*Cholesterol per serving: 56.25Zmg
